name: dsh-image-upscale
description: Upscale an image the way the web actually needs it: four `upscale_*` tools that run a REAL super-resolution model (Real-ESRGAN via the machine's own Python + torch), write a NEW file instead of replacing the original, and attach the numbers - model, device, milliseconds, bytes - to the answer. Zero npm dependencies, no engine bundled, no download without a confirmed model name.
